reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but its downloader copies Akahu and replacement unlinking duplicates unlinkAccount's local update.

duplication.why: The change adds a nearly identical transaction downloader and a second definition of the fields cleared when unlinking an account.

placement.why: Link validation and orchestration, transaction downloading, configuration, and provider types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The edits support the requested linking rules and provider integration, with only necessary client provider-map additions and a release note.

maintainability.why: Shared validation limits rule duplication, but the misleading assertion name, separately threaded replacement IDs, and copied unlink and download logic increase maintenance costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts: linkBankSyncAccount reproduces unlinkAccount's local clearing operation; extract that operation for both paths while retaining provider cleanup exclusively in unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The downloader and unlink update are straightforward copies rather than substantially reshaped duplication.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked grows closed-target validation and replacement handling through replaceExistingLink, while linkBankSyncAccount gains replacedIds and one inline unlink operation that bypasses the existing unlink abstraction.
